title: Linked compiler runtime is resolved, not authored game reconstruction
claim: The installed libgcc archive equals the public agbcc source build at da598c1d918402c42c0c0d7128ba14567f3175e9, SHA256 5086cf015e316b4dcef8952305e2e6364d835bd9a11e7328db13027359635ef9. Thirteen members are byte-identically linked into the ROM. ObjDiff complete_code expresses this resolved linked dependency separately from matched_code, which this project reserves for reconstructed C. Grant completion only after archive-hash verification; GAX does not share this provenance.

provenance.location: Compiler runtime is a resolved dependency

title: Retained binary and extracted data do not establish reconstruction
claim: The initial decomp.dev generator credited GAX and runtime by category and guessed ownership from filenames. A verified link-map snapshot replaces these assumptions. GAX, BIOS assembly wrappers and libgcc receive no reconstructed-C credit; explicit linked C data initializers receive data credit while INCBIN extraction does not. Source-hash validation prevents publishing stale snapshots. Register pins are not inline instruction replacements.

title: Three adjacent function clusters preserve ROM identity as combined TUs
claim: Nine small source files were combined into tile_grid_read, fixed_math and menu_dispatch with ROM order and compiler flags preserved. Three router resets were named for observed stores. A clean rebuild and whole-ROM make check passed. This is organization and naming work, not additional C reconstruction or an interface-conflict resolution.
